WITH target_isos AS (
  SELECT iso_id, iso_code
  FROM core.dim_iso
  WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
),
peak_hours AS (
  SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.interval_start_local, b.demand_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN target_isos i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
  WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
),
peak AS (
  SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, demand_mw
  FROM peak_hours
  WHERE rn = 1
),
shares AS (
  SELECT p.iso_id,
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END)
         / MAX(b.net_generation_mw) AS renewable_share_pct
  FROM peak p
  JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly b
    ON b.iso_id = p.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  GROUP BY p.iso_id
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN s.renewable_share_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN s.renewable_share_pct END) AS percentage_point_difference
FROM shares s
JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = s.iso_id

WITH iso_peaks AS (
  SELECT i.iso_id, i.iso_code, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
    AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'

), peak_hours AS (

), shares AS (

  JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly b ON b.iso_id = p.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc

queries.query:
WITH selected_forecast AS (
    SELECT f.iso_id, f.interval_start_utc, f.interval_start_local, f.forecast_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY f.iso_id, f.interval_start_utc
               ORDER BY f.publish_time_utc DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM core.pjm_load_forecast_hourly AS f
    WHERE f.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
      AND f.interval_start_local <  TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
      AND f.publish_time_utc < f.interval_start_utc
), hourly_errors AS (
    SELECT f.forecast_mw - b.demand_mw AS signed_error_mw
    FROM selected_forecast AS f
    JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
      ON b.iso_id = f.iso_id
     AND b.interval_start_utc = f.interval_start_utc
    WHERE f.rn = 1
      AND b.demand_mw IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(signed_error_mw) AS mean_signed_load_forecast_error_mw
FROM hourly_errors
